218f27da1f5e09ea.description:
Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. The company is moving quickly to launch the first aircraft designed specifically for swarming, as well as the Command & Control software to mobilize swarms of thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets and empower human operators to achieve superhuman results.
The team has created and exited multiple startups, negotiated defense deals worth billions of dollars, and designed and built 30+ novel aircraft, with aerospace experience from Scaled Composites, Airbus, Archer Aviation, Blue Origin, and Boom Supersonic.

The Role
Great technology loses to good technology that reaches the customer first. You'll hire the people who make sure ours gets there, and the people who keep the company running while it scales.
This seat owns hiring for Mission and defense business development, business operations, finance and accounting, real estate, and marketing. The searches are fewer, but every one of them matters. Many are the first hire in a function: the finance leader who takes us into our next stage, the real estate lead who helps stand up a new facility, the capture and program people who put our aircraft and software in front of the warfighter. We treat them like the high-stakes searches they are.

The Work
• 
Own full-cycle hiring across Mission, business operations, finance and accounting, real estate, and marketing
• 
Recruit defense BD, capture, program, and mission roles with real credibility, and know where those people come from: primes, defense tech startups, the Pentagon, and the operational force
• 
Run senior and first-of-kind searches like an executive search partner: map the market, calibrate early, and close hard
• 
Be the advisor first-time hiring managers didn't know they needed. Challenge the role when it's wrong and help define what great looks like
• 
Build relationships with future leaders before we need them, so the next search starts warm
• 
Convince exceptional people who never pictured themselves in defense that this is the most important work they'll ever do

You
• 
Have [5+] years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including senior or executive-level searches
• 
Have recruited in or around defense, government, or national security, and know the difference between BD, capture, and program management
• 
Have closed candidates who had other options, including at the leadership level
• 
Earn hiring managers' trust by telling them the truth about the market, even when it's not what they want to hear
• 
Love range. A controller, a head of marketing, and a defense BD lead in the same week sounds like a good week to you

Bonus Points
• 
Executive search or agency background paired with in-house startup experience
• 
A network in the defense BD, capture, or military community
• 
Experience hiring finance, real estate, or marketing leaders at a scaling company
• 
Military service or experience recruiting veterans and transitioning service members

Why This Seat
You'll build the teams that take our technology to the fight, and the teams that keep us standing while we grow.

How We Recruit
We're a small recruiting team building a defense company that has to win. Here's how we operate, and we hire recruiters who already work this way.
The Standard. We know the work deeply. We are not generalists hiding behind job descriptions; we study the engineering, the domain, and the landscape until we can hold a real conversation with a practitioner. Every candidate who talks to us should call it the best recruiting experience of their career, and we each bring our own personality to get there. High touch, never scripted.

How We Think. One foot old school, one foot forward: we're obsessive about the fundamentals of recruiting and restless about finding better ways to do it. We play the long game and hire for what someone will do in two and five years, not just next quarter. And we'd rather define the industry standard than follow it.

How We Operate. Mission first, always. Speed is a competitive weapon, and we use it. Quality over comfort: we'll have the harder conversation with a hiring manager before we'll make the easy hire.

If that reads like a description of how you already work, we want to talk.

Swarm Aero is an equal opportunity employer. We value diverse backgrounds and experiences and make employment decisions without regard to race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, or disability.

What We Offer

•

• 
Medical, dental, vision, and 401k
• 
PTO and paid sick leave
• 
Monthly wellness stipend
• 
Daily catered lunch (office)
• 
Paid parental leave
• 
Direct impact on a critical national security mission
• 
A world-class team of engineers and operators solving genuinely hard problems

Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

Everpure is building a global practice for Managed Service Providers from zero: The program, the proposition, and the wins that prove it out. As Senior Solutions Architect, MSP, you're the technical front line: helping define how Everpure goes to market with MSPs, then taking that straight to the field to win deals.
